review_candidates.title: Director of Growth | Dubai, UAE
review_candidates.description: About Moove Moove is building the world’s largest fleet and best-in-class technologies to power mobility platforms. Our flagship Drive-to-Own (DTO) product democratises access to vehicle ownership with a revolutionary revenue-based financing model, enabling underserved mobility entrepreneurs to thrive. Our global growth has been fuelled by our partnership with Uber and backed by leading investors and lenders, including Uber, Mubadala, BlackRock, and many others. Today, Moove operates the world's largest manned & autonomous ride-hail fleet, with 38k+ vehicles across 29 cities, 13 countries and 6 continents enabled by 2.1k+ employees – Moove continues to expand through strategic partnerships with industry leaders like Uber. We’re transforming mobility to be safer, more efficient, and accessible to all, while creating economic opportunities and supporting skills development in the mobility sector. About The Role This role reports into the Country Manage, UAE and owns the growth strategy of Moove AV, UAE. You are responsible for generating demand for our Autonomous Vehicle services. You control the revenue side of the business such as demand generation(app, direct bookings, third-party platform, owning CAC/LTV economics), pricing architecture, partnerships, agreements, relationships, events, MICE contracts, enterprise transport RFPs. It is a revenue-focused and channel-strategy role to acquire, grow and retain both consumer and corporate demand. You will build and lead the growth function and oversee both the marketing and business development that will drive this growth. What You’ll Be Doing Role Expectations Growth Strategy & Business Case Own and continuously update the demand-generation strategy: market sizing vis-a-vis fare structures, channel mix, CAC/LTV by segment, and capital efficiency. Build the B2B vs. B2C revenue mix plan and defend it with data and clearly defined unit economics. Decide channel investment priorities , set and own the growth roadmap for the business. Business Development and Revenue Work closely with the Program Manager to originate and close enterprise and government-adjacent contracts (corporate mobility accounts, hotel groups, airport authorities, free zones, tourism/event bodies). Structure and negotiate commercial terms, SLAs, and volume commitments. Lead all commercial negotiations and relationships with any 3rd party platforms, commercial or government. Develop pricing proposals, commercial models, and contract terms for each client segment in partnership with the Program Manager Growth Strategy and Funnel Ownership Own the full demand funnel from first awareness through to passenger acquisition and retention, with measurable targets at every stage Design and run structured growth experiments across channels, pricing, onboarding mechanics, and referral programmes. Define and report on the commercial KPIs the business is measured by. Own the passenger acquisition strategy including platform distribution, corporate channel, and any consumer-facing growth levers that emerge post-launch Marketing and Brand Oversight Oversee the marketing function, ensuring all brand and content activity is tied to a commercial outcome Set the direction for pre-launch demand building, including how Moove AV enters the market, builds an audience, and converts attention into demand Ensure marketing and commercial activity are coordinated to meet business objectives. Commercial Intelligence and Relationships Stay close to the market, tracking competitor moves, pricing changes, regulatory developments, and partnership opportunities as they emerge Build and maintain the commercial relationships that matter, both externally with clients and partners, and internally with the operations team Give the Program Manager a clear and accurate view of pipeline health, revenue trajectory, and commercial risks on a regular basis What You Will Need For This Position 8+ years in growth, commercial, or B2D/B2B partnerships roles, roles with direct, hands-on experience in ride-hailing or mobility, with a track record of owning and meeting revenue targets and growth metrics simultaneously. Proven experience closing complex, multi-stakeholder B2B deals in the UAE or GCC, ideally in mobility, logistics, SaaS, or marketplace businesses. Quantitative and data driven: build commercial models, design growth experiments, interpret funnel data, and translate all of it into decisions independently Experience managing or overseeing a marketing or content function with accountability for brand-to-revenue conversion. Deep understanding of the UAE business landscape: free zones, government procurement processes, local commercial culture, and platform dynamics Comfortable operating in a pre-revenue, fast-moving environment where the product is being built while you are selling and growing it Exceptional communicator and negotiator: equally credible closing a government partnership and presenting a growth model to the board Fluent in English. Arabic is a significant advantage Education Bachelor's degree in Business or a related field What Does Success Look Like The commercial pipeline is in place before the first vehicle goes live Revenue is growing in a way the business can sustain The marketing and BD functions are aligned and operating as one commercial team The Program Manager and leadership team have a reliable picture of commercial performance You have established a foundation that a BD lead and a marketing lead can step into and run. Who You'll Be Working with: Directly reporting to our Program Manager, and closely working with our Operations Team. About The Team Our team is collaborative, positive, curious, and engaged. We think fast, work smart, laugh often, and are looking for like-minded people to join us in our mission to disrupt vehicle ownership and make financial freedom within reach. Moove is strongly committed to diversity within its community. The Company’s approved Employment Equity Plan and Targets will be considered as part of the recruitment process. As an Equal Opportunities employer, we welcome people from all backgrounds who seek the opportunity to help build a future where everyone and everything can move independently. Pre-hiring Notice: Moove relies on the accuracy of information contained in employment applications, as well as the accuracy of other data presented throughout the hiring process and during employment. Any misrepresentations, falsifications, or material omissions in any information or data provided by an applicant may result in the applicant being excluded from further consideration for employment or if an individual has already been hired, termination of employment. EEO Statement: Moove is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of gender, race, sexual orientation, marital status, religion, political affiliation or any other protected characteristic.

review_candidates.title: Director - Loyalty Customer Success Lead - West Arabia & Africa
review_candidates.description: Our Purpose Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential. Title And Summary Director - Loyalty Customer Success Lead - West Arabia & Africa Overview Mastercard’s Loyalty Solutions team is seeking a Director, Program Management (EEMEA) to lead post sale customer success delivery for a regional portfolio of issuers, merchants, and partners in the West Arabia and Africa Division. This role is accountable for helping customers realize measurable business outcomes through our loyalty, rewards, and customer engagement solutions—driving platform adoption, customer value, and long term growth. The Director will lead a team across the region supporting Rewards, Offers, and program operations and implementations, ensuring strong delivery quality and operational excellence across markets with varying levels of loyalty maturity. The role will partner closely with Sales, Product, and Delivery to influence key commercial and customer KPIs—including renewals, retention, ARR expansion, and NPS—and will build senior client relationships to maintain momentum, mitigate risk, and identify new value for customers and Mastercard. Success in this role requires deep expertise in digital marketing, loyalty best practices, and complex program management. Candidates with superior communication and collaboration skills are a must, as is the ability to align resources and solve complex problems in a matrixed environment. Role-Key Responsibilities Drive Regional Adoption & Value: Define and execute customer success plans across the region to drive measurable improvements in engagement, retention, and program performance. Monitor KPIs and trends across the portfolio and coach team members to deliver insights and recommendations to clients. Relationship Management: Serve as a senior point of contact for key accounts and engage as an account sponsor for select strategic clients. Build trusted relationships with stakeholders across Marketing, CRM, Loyalty, and executive teams to ensure alignment on objectives and value realization. Strategic Guidance: Provide thought leadership and data-driven insights to shape client program roadmaps and regional best practices. Build feedback loops to bring market insights to Product, Sales, and Delivery teams to improve offerings and execution. Program Governance: Establish and run portfolio governance, including business reviews, performance reporting, and customer health/risk management. Drive adoption of consistent, data-driven approaches to value tracking, issue escalation, and remediation plans. Growth & Retention: Drive upsells, renewal readiness and retention outcomes across the portfolio. Partner with Sales and Account Management to support renewals and identify expansion/cross-sell opportunities. Contribute to forecasting and pipeline health by surfacing risks and value stories early. Leadership & Development: Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing regional team through regular 1:1s, coaching plans, and timely performance feedback. Set clear goals and expectations, create growth opportunities, and reinforce consistent delivery standards and ways of working. About You Experience 8–10+ years in customer success, account management, program management, or consulting for enterprise SaaS Strong experience with loyalty, CRM, marketing, or customer engagement programs, or related fintech solutions Proven track record of hitting renewal targets, driving incremental value, and retaining long-term contracts Expertise overseeing or closely partnering with operations, delivery, or similar functions in a complex cross-functional environment. Skills Strong commercial acumen, with the ability to link loyalty program success to financial and business outcomes. Excellent executive communication and presentation skills Highly analytical and comfortable using data to inform strategy and recommendations Proven people leadership skills, including leading managers and/or senior individual contributors across multiple markets and influencing in a matrixed environment Technical Knowledge Familiarity with loyalty platforms, rewards ecosystems, CRM tools, and marketing and financial technology (APIs, integrations, etc.) High degree of comfort working with analytics dashboards and translating insights into action Attributes Empathy and a strong ability to understand customer goals and needs Strategic, proactive, outcomes-oriented Preferred Qualifications Experience with loyalty program design and optimization. Knowledge of data-driven marketing strategies. Familiarity with tools such as Salesforce, loyalty platforms, and analytics solutions. Corporate Security Responsibility All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must: Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices; Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed; Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

review_candidates.title: Directeur Développement Réseau & Ventes France (Automobile)
review_candidates.description: À propos du poste Dans le cadre de son développement en France, notre entreprise recherche un Directeur Réseau de Distributeurs chargé de piloter l’expansion commerciale et la structuration du réseau de distribution automobile. Ce poste a pour mission principale de développer de nouveaux partenaires distributeurs, d’assurer la performance commerciale du réseau existant et d’accompagner l’implantation sur de nouveaux marchés. Véritable acteur de terrain et du développement business, le candidat contribuera directement à la croissance de l’entreprise en France à travers la mise en place d’un réseau solide, performant et durable. Responsabilités 1. Développement du réseau de distribution en France Élaborer et mettre en œuvre la stratégie de développement et d’expansion du réseau de distributeurs afin d’assurer une couverture optimale des marchés clés; Identifier, évaluer et recruter des distributeurs disposant de solides capacités financières et commerciales; Piloter les négociations commerciales et contractuelles afin d’accélérer l’implantation sur de nouveaux marchés. 2. Réalisation des objectifs commerciaux Assumer l’entière responsabilité de la performance commerciale globale du réseau de distributeurs sous gestion; Garantir l’atteinte des objectifs de vente annuels et trimestriels; Décliner les objectifs de vente auprès des distributeurs et mettre en place des mécanismes de suivi et de pilotage de la performance; Accompagner les distributeurs dans l’amélioration des ventes, du taux de conversion et de la rotation des stocks; Élaborer et suivre des plans d’actions correctifs pour les distributeurs sous-performants. 3. Pilotage du réseau et amélioration de la performance Mettre en place un système de suivi des données commerciales (ventes, stocks, performance marché); Coordonner les ressources marketing afin de soutenir les distributeurs clés et améliorer la conversion en point de vente; Déployer des mécanismes de suivi des risques afin de prévenir les surstocks et les risques opérationnels. 4. Management et accompagnement des distributeurs Organiser des programmes de formation pour les distributeurs afin de renforcer leurs compétences commerciales et l’application des standards de la marque; Accompagner les distributeurs dans la mise en œuvre d’actions marketing et promotionnelles locales; Réaliser des visites régulières des distributeurs afin de résoudre les problématiques opérationnelles et renforcer les partenariats. Profil recherché Expérience solide dans l’industrie automobile ou dans la vente via réseau de distribution; Expérience confirmée dans le développement de réseaux de distributeurs, avec des résultats concrets en expansion de réseau fortement appréciés; Bonne maîtrise des modèles de distribution automobile (réseaux de distributeurs, agents régionaux, etc.); Une expérience en participation ou en pilotage du développement de marchés régionaux ou de l’entrée sur de nouveaux marchés est un plus. Ce que nous offrons: Une rémunération compétitive composée d’un salaire fixe + une prime variable liée à la performance du réseau. Candidature Merci d’envoyer votre CV à : qiaomin.chen@kngloo.eu ou yiting.wu@kngloo.eu

Mace combines construction expertise with consultancy to unlock potential in every person or project and redefine the boundaries of ambition. Our values shape the way we consult and define the people we want to join us on our journey. The Project This is an opportunity to work on one of the largest and most prestigious mixed-use developments in the UAE. The project comprises a landmark masterplan incorporating a Grade A+ office tower, luxury hotels, branded residences, retail, hospitality, public realm, and associated infrastructure. Mace is supporting the delivery of this flagship development and is seeking high-calibre professionals to help realise a world-class destination that sets new benchmarks in design excellence, functionality, commercial performance and user experience. The Role Mace is seeking an experienced Development Director - Grade A+ Commercial Office Tower to lead the end-to-end development, delivery, and commercial success of a globally significant trophy commercial office tower within a prestigious mixed-use development. Acting as the client's representative, you will provide strategic leadership throughout the entire project lifecycle, driving development strategy, design excellence, commercial performance, stakeholder engagement, procurement, construction delivery, leasing readiness, and market positioning. Responsible for ensuring the successful integration of the commercial tower within the wider masterplan while creating a globally competitive office destination capable of attracting international blue-chip occupiers, institutional investors, financial services firms, and private family offices. You'll Be Responsible For Acting as the client's representative and single point of accountability for the development strategy, delivery, and commercial success of the Grade A+ office tower. Establishing and implementing the development strategy, ensuring alignment with the Client's vision, commercial objectives, and wider masterplan aspirations. Providing leadership and oversight of architectural, engineering, interior design, workplace, sustainability, and specialist consultant teams. Managing development budgets, business plans, financial performance, programme delivery, risk management, and investment objectives. Identifying and mitigating development, commercial, design, construction, leasing, and operational risks throughout the project lifecycle. Providing strategic reporting to senior executives and stakeholders on development performance, risk, programme, budget, leasing readiness and investment outcomes. Works collaboratively towards the common goal of net zero carbon transition and share responsibility for the proactive identification and management of the associated carbon emissions and reductions during the delivery of work. You'll Need To Have Bachelor's degree in Real Estate Development, Architecture, Engineering, Construction Management, Urban Development, Finance or a related discipline (Master's degree preferred). Proven experience acting as a client representative with full accountability for development strategy, commercial performance, and project delivery. Experience leading multidisciplinary consultant, design, construction, commercial, and operational teams on complex mixed-use developments. Strong financial acumen with experience managing business plans, development appraisals, budgets, cash flow, investment performance, and commercial decision-making. Strong knowledge of procurement, development management, project delivery, contract administration, and governance processes. Experience delivering high-profile mixed-use developments incorporating commercial office, hospitality, residential, retail, and public realm components. Exceptional leadership, stakeholder management, negotiation, presentation, and communication skills. Our values Safety first - Going home safe and well: We champion a safe, diverse, and inclusive working environment, understanding the importance of well-being in every team. Client focus - Deliver on our promise: We own the quality of deliverables and strategic outcomes and build long-term relationships with our clients. Integrity - Always do the right thing: We influence positive outcomes within our industry while always aligning with our compliance obligations. Create opportunity - For our people to excel: We champion a continuous improvement culture throughout all activities, inspiring our people and teams to develop. Mace is an inclusive employer and welcomes interest from a diverse range of candidates. Even if you feel you do not fulfill all the criteria, please apply, as you may still be the best candidate for this role or another role within our organisation. We are also open to discussing part-time, flexible, and hybrid working options if suitable within the role.

It is a generative AI system: models, LLM applications, and agents that hold tools and act on what they are told. You will attack those systems and write up what you find. If you have spent years breaking web applications and have started turning that instinct on LLMs, this is the work. What you will do - Probe LLM applications and agentic systems for exploitable behaviour: prompt injection, both direct and indirect, guardrail and policy bypass, system prompt extraction, tool and function-call abuse, data exfiltration through RAG pipelines, privilege escalation across agent boundaries. - Prove impact, not just output. A jailbreak that reaches nothing is a curiosity. - Write findings the client can act on: reproduction steps, root cause in the agent or tool design, severity, and a mapping to the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications. - Work to a defined scope and stay inside it. What we are looking for - Real exposure to generative AI security, professional or self-directed. Personal research counts here, and we will ask you to show it. - Fluent written English. The report is the deliverable. - Evidence we can verify: a CVE credit, a public bug bounty profile, a vendor acknowledgement, a published write-up or advisory, a conference talk, or an issuer verification link for the certifications you hold. - Willingness to complete an identity check and sign an NDA before touching any client system. Nice to have - Around 5 years of hands-on web penetration testing. If your track record is shorter but backed by published AI security work, apply anyway and tell us what you have done. - Offensive security certifications in the OSCP / OSWE / OSCE3 or GIAC families. - Python or NodeJS, enough to build your own harness. - A Hack The Box, TryHackMe or CTFtime profile. - A degree in computer science or information security. How to apply Complete our short screening form. It takes about 10 minutes and asks for your experience, your verification links and your hourly rate. Every submission is reviewed by a person. Candidates who pass that review are invited to a practical challenge on the client's portal.

review_candidates.title: DevOps Engineer
review_candidates.description: The Role The DevOps Engineer plays a key role in designing, building, and operating APM’s cloud and platform capabilities, enabling secure, reliable, and scalable technology delivery across the organisation. This role is responsible for driving automation, standardisation, and DevSecOps practices across the technology lifecycle, supporting both infrastructure and application delivery through modern engineering approaches. Based in Perth, Sydney, or Melbourne, this is an exciting opportunity to work within a global environment and contribute to the evolution of APM’s cloud platforms and engineering capability. In This Role You Will Design, build, and operate Azure cloud environments across development, test, and production Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps and/or GitHub Actions Implement and manage Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform Embed DevSecOps practices, including security controls, scanning, and governance in pipelines Automate infrastructure and application delivery to improve reliability and reduce manual effort Implement monitoring, logging, and alerting using Azure-native tools Support incident response, problem management, and root cause analysis Collaborate with engineering, infrastructure, and security teams to improve platform maturity Contribute to platform standards, architecture, and roadmaps Drive continuous improvement through automation, standardisation, and optimisation initiatives Participate in an on-call support rotation to support critical services Skills You’ll Bring 5+ years’ experience working in Azure / Microsoft cloud environments or Systems Engineering roles Strong hands-on experience with Terraform and Infrastructure as Code principles Proven experience building and managing CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions) Strong understanding of cloud architecture, networking, identity, and security Experience implementing DevSecOps practices, including security scanning and governance Knowledge of monitoring and observability tools (e.g. Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, App Insights) Familiarity with security frameworks and standards (e.g. NIST, ISO, CIS) Exposure to cloud security, vulnerability management, and compliance requirements Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work in a fast-paced, evolving environment Excellent communication and collaboration skills across technical and business stakeholders What’s in it for you? Working with a global organisation, you’ll play a key role in shaping and evolving APM’s cloud and platform engineering capabilities. You’ll Have The Opportunity To Work with modern technologies and contribute to next-generation cloud platforms Embed best-practice DevOps and DevSecOps frameworks across a growing organisation Influence how applications and infrastructure are delivered at scale Grow your career within a global business spanning 11 countries We offer flexible / hybrid working, access to the latest tools and technology, additional leave options, health discounts, and a comprehensive range of employee benefits. About APM Group We’re a diverse team of over 16,000 people across 11 countries with a shared purpose - to enable better lives. Our purpose is the common thread that lives in everything we do, and it starts with enabling better lives for our employees and their families too. Our work enables the people we serve to realise their ambitions and aspirations through sustainable employment, independence, better health, and wellbeing, and increased social participation. When you join APM, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career across global brands and geographies while making a meaningful difference. At APM we are strengthened by diversity. We are committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels included, respected, and valued. We encourage applications from people of all ages, nationalities, abilities, and cultures, including Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples, the LGBTQI+ community, and people with disability. Ready to Join? Click APPLY now and submit your application via our online recruitment platform. For a confidential discussion, please contact Shane Bhan at Shane.bhan@apm.net.au .

review_candidates.title: DevOps Engineer
review_candidates.description: A Digital Wealth Management house requires a development operations engineer to work on a brand new, web & mobile platform they are building from scratch. As a business, their focus is on the personal relationship they develop with customers, underpinned by multi-channel customer reach and global investment expertise via a digital Investment Management platform. Entirely in the cloud, taking advantage of powerful commoditised offerings, the firm is building a bespoke cloud-native solution. Backed by one of the largest names in the Asset Management space, this FinTech was created 4 years ago, and, whilst having the stability and backing of a major firm, build their own technology. Whilst their current product has been running for 4 years, the reason this hire is critical, is the firm are about to embark and build a brand-new product from scratch. As the Senior Platform Engineer, you will act as a hands-on technical leader within the Platform & Infrastructure team, helping shape and deliver the organisation's cloud and infrastructure strategy. You will play a key role in designing, building, and operating a secure, scalable Azure estate, enabling development teams to deliver applications efficiently through modern platform capabilities including CI/CD, Infrastructure-as-Code, Kubernetes, and observability tooling. Working closely with engineering and architecture teams, you will support cloud adoption and application modernisation initiatives, ensuring solutions are resilient, compliant, and operationally ready from day one. You will champion engineering best practices and platform standardisation, driving automation and operational excellence across the technology function. You will take ownership of complex technical challenges, leading the implementation of delivery pipelines and reusable platform services using technologies such as GitLab, Terraform, Helm, and Kubernetes. In addition, you will contribute to the growth of the wider team through technical mentorship, knowledge sharing, and the development of architecture documentation, standards, and operational procedures, helping to establish a robust and future-proof platform capability. Office set up: 📍The role is a hybrid role, with 3 days per week in the office. Based in London City with access to major tube stations. ✅Responsibilities: You have a solid understanding of the opportunities of cloud computing and how to use it well. Experienced in an Azure environment with microservices architecture. You have worked on public-facing systems, and understand how to build them to be secure, scalable and resilient. You can clearly articulate what DevOps and DevSecOps mean to you, and what a healthy approach is to these concepts. You have experience in driving adoption and defining best practice, and guiding developers in adhering to these. You understand how and where quality can be tested in automated CI/CD pipelines. You retain hands on engineering skills in some or all of our core technical stack: Terraform/PowerShell/Kubernetes/Azure . ☁️Technology: Azure, EKS, Terraform, Kubernetes, Automated CI/CD Pipelines, DevSecOps monitoring tools If you are interested in this engineer role, please reply to this advert with your latest CV or send it to shabana@virtuetech.io
